summary: Ucommune International Ltd (Nasdaq: UK) filed a Form 6-K disclosing a securities purchase agreement dated May 6, 2026, under which it issued 150 Series A Convertible Preferred Shares at $10,000 per share to an institutional investor. Proceeds partially funded the purchase of NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU server equipment, which was leased to a QumulusAI subsidiary under a ~$1.3M, three-year lease with a purchase option, marking the company's entry into compute infrastructure. The filing includes a two-year lockup on equity issuances and a ban on variable rate transactions. The private placement exempt under Rule 506(b). This is a capital-raise and business-expansion disclosure, not a special situation. Watch for shareholder dilution upon conversion and lease performance.
